headline: Passenger bus set on fire in Baridhara, no casualties reported
summary: A Boishakhi Paribahan bus was engulfed in flames on Friday evening in Dhaka's Baridhara area; the driver and helper are currently being questioned by police.
details: A passenger bus belonging to Boishakhi Paribahan was set on fire in the J Block of Road No. 7 in Dhaka’s Baridhara on Friday.
The fire broke out at 5:48 pm, quickly engulfing the vehicle. No casualties have been reported so far.
Two units from the Baridhara Fire Station arrived at the scene by 5:57 pm and successfully brought the flames under control.
Bhatara Police Station officials moved the bus from the spot to clear the road.
The driver and the helper of the bus have been taken to the police station for questioning to determine the cause of the fire.
caption:
A passenger bus was engulfed in flames in Dhaka's Baridhara on Friday evening.

A passenger bus belonging to Boishakhi Paribahan was set on fire in the J Block of Road No. 7 in Dhaka’s Baridhara on Friday.

The fire broke out at 5:48 pm, quickly engulfing the vehicle. No casualties have been reported so far.

Two units from the Baridhara Fire Station arrived at the scene by 5:57 pm and successfully brought the flames under control.

Bhatara Police Station officials moved the bus from the spot to clear the road.

The driver and the helper of the bus have been taken to the police station for questioning to determine the cause of the fire.

headline: 1,535 hospitalised as 3 more die of dengue in 24 hours
summary: The death toll has risen to 455 with 145,906 cumulative cases reported across Bangladesh.
details: At least three dengue patients died and 1,535 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
Of the reported deaths, two occurred in the Dhaka division and one in the Khulna division.
With these latest fatalities, the total death toll has risen to 455, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 145,906.
Currently, 5,773 dengue patients are undergoing treatment in hospitals across the country.
caption:
1,535 hospitalised in just 24 hours. The dengue crisis continues to claim lives across Bangladesh.

At least three dengue patients died and 1,535 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

Of the reported deaths, two occurred in the Dhaka division and one in the Khulna division.

With these latest fatalities, the total death toll has risen to 455, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 145,906.

Currently, 5,773 dengue patients are undergoing treatment in hospitals across the country.
